name: Prune
siboNotes: High in sorbitol which can trigger SIBO symptoms. Start with very small portions and monitor tolerance carefully.
preparationTips: Stick to 2 prunes maximum per serving to stay low FODMAP
Soak in water to soften if needed for easier digestion
Space prune consumption throughout the day rather than eating multiple at once
Consider chopping into smaller pieces to add to low FODMAP portions of oatmeal or yogurt
alternatives: Fresh grapes (low FODMAP in 1 cup servings)
nutritionalHighlights: High in fiber for digestive health
